procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_270 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/greene/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (12/12).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 12); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 13 precincts (11 columns, then Mclain/Jonathan + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the Circuit 18 continuation and locals. The SEMS row-block split cut the Circuit Court 18-Circuit District 18 Place 1 section between its two candidates: Brad R. Thompson's row completes table A (under the Place 1 header at p3's bottom) and Eric Tiebauer's row starts p4 ahead of the local zone with no header repeat (the standard carry pattern); 'Circuit Court 18-Circuit District 18 Place 2' then opens with its own header and Darryl A. Hurt Jr.'s row. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 04-4th Congressional District (Mike Ezell, Jeffrey Hulum III, Carl Boyanton -- the same roster George prints, names identical); Court Of Appeals 05-District 5 Position 1 (Anthony 'Tony' Lawrence, sole candidate -- the same section George prints); Chancery Court 19-Chancery District 19 Place 1 (Jerry D. Sharp) and Place 2 (Kathryn Dickerson Clay); Circuit Court 18-Circuit District 18 Place 1 (Brad R. Thompson, Eric Tiebauer) and Place 2 (Darryl A. Hurt Jr.) -- the same Circuit 18 roster George prints, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 811, Hyde-Smith 2607, Pinkins 128, Ezell 2752, Hulum 729, Boyanton 64, Lawrence 2929, Sharp 2929, Clay 2930, Brad R. Thompson 2366, Tiebauer 736, Hurt 2968.
operator_rows_note: All 12 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (the Mclain/Jonathan cells + printed TOTAL); Tiebauer's and Hurt's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the thirteen precinct headers print complete (Leakesville, North Leakesville, State Line, Mutual Rights, Wade, Jones, Piave, Maples, Vernal, Washington Neely, Leaf, Mclain, Jonathan).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local section School Board 5-School Board District 5 (Robin McCoy, Falon McIlwain) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 19's two Places and Circuit 18's two Places print in-county, so the families write Place-qualified labels (Circuit 18's matching George's).
